why: Most of it is right. Render checks pass at 390px and 320px, and only snapshots and helpers fail in the gate. Folds start closed, there are no stratagems, and once-per-battle lines are boxes only. These are correct against the texts: Code Chivalric is one line at End of your turn, End of your opponent’s turn and End of the battle round, with its Deeds unlisted. The Blood God’s Favour is To do now at the Start of the battle round in standard, big-demons-baby and super-terminators, and also in Fight · both turns in super-terminators (Adamantine Avalanche: 'At the start of the Fight phase, … make a Blessings of Khorne roll'). Harbingers of Dread carries '(first, third and fifth battle rounds)'. Might of Khorne, Enraged Abjuration, the Canticles options, Aegis Protocol and the five unread Dread abilities are Active now in all 10 phase sections. One wrong placement, in the pk branch: Icon of War (Rod of the War Forge) · Thulia Ghuld, in purge-goes-the-foe, is under When unclear. Rod of the War Forge is a fixed-moment trigger: 'In your Command phase, select one of the abilities in the Icon of War section. Until the start of your next Command phase, this model has that ability.' The duration is read (pk = every phase). Only its use is partly unread, because The Fires of Mars is x. The owner's rule is that what a fixed-moment trigger puts in force goes under Active now, for 'the whole duration if its use can't be read'. When unclear is only for timing that cannot be read. The commit applies this rule to options (an option of which nothing is read takes its rule's whole duration: the Dread abilities, Aegis Protocol, Might of Khorne), but the selected-ability branch still sends an unread use to When unclear. The fix gives the selector's whole duration when the use is not fully read, and keeps When unclear for pk.x. Tested in a scratch copy, with every list rendered: Icon of War moves from When unclear to Active now in all 10 phase sections, and nothing else changes. render.js passes with the matching change: `const u2 = e0.pk.x ? '' : use ? within(use, e0.pk.u) : e0.pk.u`. Note, not a fix: The Blood God’s Favour now reads '· Angron', not '(Wrathful Presence)', although it is only active while Wrathful Presence has selected it. Wrathful Presence is the line above it, at the same moment.

`e.rolled` was added to s, stored and once. It matches render.js, which skips a rolled selected ability, and wants the rolled entry at its moments. Rolled entries on screen: The Blood God’s Favour in 3 lists, and Icon of Khorne in princes, standard and big-demons-baby. Nothing else is newly listed.

An option with x but its own u now takes that u, since `o.x` is no longer checked first. One with neither takes the rule's oc or pk, with via. Checked on screen against the texts. Harbingers ('Any Dread abilities that have been selected are active until the end of the battle') puts Deathly Terror, Despair, Darkness, Delirium and Dominion in every phase. Doom keeps its own u, and Dismay its Command · Their turn. Canticles ('Until the start of your next Command phase') puts Mantra of Discipline, Binharic Courage and Shroudpsalm in every phase, from your Command phase. Battle Protocols ('it remains in that protocol until it enters a different one') puts Aegis Protocol in every phase. Protector Protocol and Conqueror Protocol keep their own u. Blood Tithe ('until the end of the battle') puts Might of Khorne in every phase. Kindred Sorcery's once-per-battle options stay as boxes in Command · Your turn only (via). No option in data.js has x with u or t (scanned). render.js differs only in that unreached case (x with u: render takes oc), so nothing renders differently today.

The only change is the MORTAL_GUARD override of u. It matches three texts, all permanent protections: Unnatural Resistance ('Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Mortal Wounds'), Aegis of the Emperor ('Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds') and Blood Tithe's Enraged Abjuration. Unnatural Resistance and Aegis of the Emperor are not listed (no fixed moment), so the screen does not change for them. The rest is unchanged from the version approved before. Note: the override ignores any duration in the same text. A future 'until the end of the phase, … Feel No Pain … against mortal wounds' would get every phase. A safer form intersects with the text's own duration. No current text is affected.

It takes the first DURATIONS match anywhere in the rule's own words, and DURATIONS' 'turn' includes a bare 'this turn'. Cabal of Sorcerers' own words, 'select one model … that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn', give data.js `oc:{u:'shooting:your,charge:your,fight:your'}`. That says its Rituals are in force in Charge and Fight of your turn, but the rule gives its options no duration (Destiny’s Ruin and Twist of Fate each say 'Until the end of the phase'). It does not show today, because every Cabal option has its own u. But if any option were left without a u, it would be placed by a guessed duration, against 'never guessed'. The third review already said to limit this to 'until …' durations. The fix counts only matches that begin with 'until'. Tested in a scratch copy with derive --write: only Cabal's oc disappears. Harbingers, Blood Tithe, Kindred Sorcery, Malefic Surge, Doctrina Imperatives, Blessings of Khorne, Canticles and Battle Protocols keep theirs. Every list's checklist is unchanged, and render.js passes.

Checked against Code Chivalric's table (data.js, the same on Wahapedia imperial-knights). Deed 1–2, 'completed at the end of a turn', gives End of your turn and End of your opponent’s turn. Deed 3–4, 'at the end of your opponent’s turn', gives End of your opponent’s turn. Deed 5–6, 'at the end of the battle round', gives End of the battle round. The alternation backtracks correctly from 'your' to 'your opponent’s'. 'until the end of …' is stripped, and phase ends do not match. Code Chivalric's options are the only ones in data.js with ends (scanned). The rule shows once in each of the three sections, To do now, in 6-bigs and 4-megas-and-a-destrier, and its Qualities are not listed (the owner: one line).

Matches only protections. Scanned every rule, option and ability text: Enraged Abjuration ('Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds'), Unnatural Resistance and Aegis of the Emperor. Offensive mortal-wound texts (Doombolt, Delirium, Cabal's test) do not match. Enraged Abjuration is now Active now in all 10 phase sections of big-demons-baby, which is right for 'until the end of the battle'. Note: in ruleTables, `e.x` is set from `ph`, which does not include the EVERY_PHASE override. A future protection option with no other phase read would get x together with u, and app.html and render.js treat that case differently (see ckOption). No text does this today.

Scanned all texts. The only named rolls a listed rule makes are Blessings of Khorne ('at the start of the battle round, you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll': at Start of the battle round) and Adamantine Avalanche ('At the start of the Fight phase, if a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit is engaged, make a Blessings of Khorne roll': fight:either). Sentences with 'each time you make' (Icon of Khorne, The Blood God’s Favour) are skipped as intended, and `**` is stripped before matching. Only listed entries (s or stored) count. Minor: the first `at` found wins. Two rules making the same roll at different moments would keep one. No list has that.

Applied to Icon of Khorne and The Blood God’s Favour, the only 'Each time you make a X roll' texts. Both are To do now at the Start of the battle round. In super-terminators The Blood God’s Favour is also in Fight · both turns. Entries listed by their own moment (s) are left alone. A rolled entry clears x, so the stored path doesn't run, and the pk branch skips it (listed itself). The Blood God’s Favour no longer appears as '(Wrathful Presence)' Active now, which matches render.js's `rolled(eP, P)` skip. Note: the app looks up `named` (the list's unit abilities and rules), while render.js reads the text directly. They agree today because The Blood God’s Favour is on Angron's datasheet.
